verdict.rationale: Azure documents a platform-wide CLI for managing Azure resources and a central REST API reference hub that refers to 'Azure service REST APIs' broadly. A non-flagship service (Cost Management) has its own REST API reference, so reference coverage extends beyond core compute and storage. Nothing in the pack shows that every service has consistent, complete API and CLI reference pages. missing for 10: evidence of reference coverage across all services, evidence of consistency in reference format and depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of reference quality.

support.subject: As a developer, every service has a real reference — consistent API/CLI reference docs across the platform, not just the flagship services

citations.quote: Azure CLI is a cross-platform command-line tool for managing Azure resources with interactive commands or scripts.
Most Azure service REST APIs have client libraries that provide a native interface for using Azure services
The Cost Management APIs provide the ability to explore cost and usage data via multidimensional analysis
How to register your client application with Microsoft Entra ID to secure your REST requests.
